style_summary: A horizontal 3:2 biography poster merging the strict, rational grid systems of Swiss International Style with raw physical collage elements. The left 40% features a high-contrast, halftone-printed portrait cutout with rough torn-paper edges. The right 60% is a pristine typographic grid rendering a multi-line chronological timeline. The color palette is highly restrained to aged parchment, dark charcoal ink, and a single vibrant accent color. The aesthetic is intellectual, historically weighty, and brutally clean.

environment_variables.SUBJECT_NAME: The main headline name. e.g., 'ANDREJ KARPATHY'
environment_variables.SUBJECT_PORTRAIT: Description of the person for the left column. e.g., 'A thoughtful portrait of Andrej Karpathy wearing casual tech attire'
environment_variables.ACCENT_COLOR_NAME: The semantic name of the brand/accent color. e.g., 'Anthropic Peach' or 'Swiss Red'
environment_variables.TIMELINE_DATA: The exact chronological text block to be rendered in the right column. (Can be up to 10-15 lines)

zones.left_portrait_zone: Occupies the left 40% of the canvas. The portrait is anchored at the bottom edge, breaking out of a torn paper frame.
zones.right_typography_zone: Occupies the right 60% of the canvas. Features an invisible but strict vertical alignment line (flush-left) where all timeline text begins.
zones.negative_space: Ample negative space above the portrait and between the timeline lines to let the parchment texture breathe.

composition.depth_logic: Literal paper stacking for the left portrait (torn paper over background), but absolutely 2D flat printing for the right typography and grid lines.
composition.scale_contrast: Massive scale for the SUBJECT_NAME, contrasting with the highly structured, medium-scale chronological TIMELINE_DATA.
composition.edge_treatment: Violent contrast: the portrait has rough, fibrous white torn edges, while all typography and background grid lines are razor-sharp vector lines.
permissions: rendering extremely long blocks of text flawlessly
applying halftone newspaper dot textures to photorealistic faces

typography.letterform_character: Distressed, letterpress, vintage newsprint, slight ink bleed, physically stamped

hierarchy.style: Heavy vintage headline sans-serif, distressed edges
hierarchy.treatment: Must show visible physical printing artifacts like faded toner and rough stamped edges

hierarchy.style: Old mechanical typewriter or hot-metal classifieds font
hierarchy.treatment: Slight variations in ink weight to simulate analog printing, meticulously aligned

typography.readability_rule: Maintain the rigorous Swiss grid alignment, but degrade the letterforms to look like an archival 1960s newspaper clipping.
text_constraints: Strictly NO crisp digital vector fonts
Text must look physically absorbed into the parchment background

color_constraints.dominant: parchment_beige acts as the canvas, charcoal_ink for all text and portraits.
color_constraints.accent_roles: primary_accent_color is used surgically: perhaps a flat geometric rectangle behind the portrait, or highlighting the most recent timeline entry.
color_constraints.special_rules: The SUBJECT_PORTRAIT must be converted strictly to a black-and-white halftone (newsprint dot) texture. No realistic skin tones.

visual_direction.material_textures: Textured aged paper, dry toner ink, fibrous torn paper.
visual_direction.print_finish: High-end vintage magazine spread / Swiss poster
visual_direction.surface_quality: Completely matte with visible paper grain.

swiss_grid_lines.placement: Creating a subtle structural grid in the background, especially a vertical line separating the year from the job title in the timeline

geometric_color_block.physical: A perfect, flat rectangle in the ACCENT_COLOR
geometric_color_block.placement: Used as a backdrop contrasting with the torn edges of the portrait

do: Strictly separate the visual zone (left) and data zone (right)
Maintain rigorous flush-left alignment for the long text block
avoid: messy or distorted fonts for the timeline
